findings.evidence: A grep for `theorem explicitCoeff1_(add|neg|zero|sub|mk|eq_nsmul)` in code/TauCeti finds only `explicitCoeff1_mk` (ExplicitFunctoriality.lean:746) and `explicitCoeff1_eq_nsmul` (:772). Map.lean contains three copies of the `refine (cocyclesMap1_apply _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ z σ)` pattern.
findings.fix: Add `explicitCoeff1_add`, `explicitCoeff1_neg` and `explicitCoeff1_zero` to `ContCohomology/ExplicitFunctoriality.lean`, next to `explicitCoeff1_eq_nsmul`. Then derive the three `pointH1Map` lemmas by `simp [pointH1Map_def, explicitCoeff1_add, ...]` together with `pointCoeffMap_add`/`_neg`/`_zero`.
findings.issue: `pointH1Map_add`, `pointH1Map_neg` and `pointH1Map_zero` each repeat the same cocycle-level argument: `QuotientAddGroup.induction_on`, then `explicitCoeff1_mk`, then `ext σ`, then `cocyclesMap1_apply _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ z σ` with 8 positional placeholders. The underlying general fact (adding coefficient maps adds the induced `explicitCoeff1` maps, and likewise for negation and zero) is buried in the elliptic-curve file, and the positional placeholders break if the signature changes.

findings.evidence: Finite.lean:57-64 and :96-106 both end with `exact Finite.of_injective (AddSubgroup.inclusion (f.ker_shafarevichTateMap_le_torsionBy τ)) (AddSubgroup.inclusion_injective _)`. Lines 67-71 and :108-112 are word-for-word the same, as are :74-83 and :114-122.
findings.fix: Prove these once in `Selmer/Isogeny/Basic.lean`, for an arbitrary family `τ`, under the hypothesis `∀ n [NeZero n], Finite (torsionBy (W.shafarevichTateGroup τ) n)` on both curves. Have it give finite kernel, then `of_finite`, then the `iff`. Each place-specific version then only supplies its torsion-finiteness proof.
findings.issue: The all-places theorems copy the finite-places ones. `finite_ker_shafarevichTateMap` repeats the `NeZero`/`ker ≤ torsionBy`/`Finite.of_injective` steps of `finite_ker_shafarevichTateMap_finitePlaces`. The bodies of `finite_shafarevichTateGroup_of_finite` and `finite_shafarevichTateGroup_iff` are copies of their `_finitePlaces` versions. Only the torsion-finiteness input differs.

summary: The prior findings are fixed: the `erw` steps are commented, the Sha inclusion is factored into `shafarevichTateGroup_le_comp` and `shafarevichTateTorsionInclusion`, and the redundant `have := h` lines are removed. Two blocks of copy-pasted reasoning remain: the same cocycle-level argument is repeated for `add`, `neg` and `zero` of the cohomology map, and the finite-places and all-places finiteness chains repeat each other.
